archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) meets Terminal Retro-Futurism

layout.style: High Density Grid (Dashboards / Analytics) - Mode B
layout.structure: Split-panel layout. Left/Top for Input Configuration, Right/Bottom for Analytics and Output.
layout.spacing_strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy but tight widget internals. Use MUI theme spacing.
layout.corners: Sharp, maximum 4px border radius. No pill shapes for generic containers.
layout.elevation: No soft shadows. Use 1px borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) to indicate depth levels.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid muddy gray. Use background #000000 with 60% opacity, strong backdrop-blur (12px), and 1px inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use subtle, monochromatic grain or noise overlays if possible.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Grid lines should be visible between major sections.

mui_customization.general: Heavily override default Material UI theme. Remove all default drop shadows (box-shadow: none). Override border radii to 0px or 4px.
mui_customization.buttons: Square or 4px radius. High contrast. Primary buttons should be White background with Black text, or Black background with White border.
mui_customization.cards: Flat background (#121214), 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover states: slight border color change.
mui_customization.textfields: Outlined variants only. Border color muted, active border stark white.

monaco_editor.config: Hide minimap, enable word wrap, remove line numbers if space is tight, use JetBrains Mono.

recharts.style: Monochromatic lines/bars with Accent color (#FF3B30 or #007AFF) for data points. Remove axis lines, use subtle dotted grid lines (stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.1)).
recharts.tooltip: Custom dark tooltip matching the surface color with 1px border.

toast.library: MUI Snackbar or Sonner if available. Keep them minimal, bottom-right, stark black background, white text, sharp edges.

motion.interactions: Fast, precise micro-interactions (0.15s - 0.2s). Hovering on cards changes border from 0.08 to 0.3 opacity.
motion.score_cards: Animate numbers counting up on analysis completion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Main text on dark background must be highly legible.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='analyze-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use Material UI (MUI) components for the UI infrastructure.
Create a custom MUI theme (createTheme) to enforce the colors, typography, and sharp shape rules defined here.
Implement a split-panel layout resembling Vercel/OpenAI Playground. The Monaco Editor goes on one side (input), and the Recharts / Score Cards / Optimized Diff go on the other.
Use Recharts for the Radar or Bar charts representing Clarity, Specificity, Ambiguity, etc.
For the side-by-side prompt comparison, build a clear diff view or dual text areas.
Prompt history should persist in localStorage and be accessible via a sidebar or drawer.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or overlapping surfaces. Always use a solid background with a border.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Strip Material UI of its 'Google' look. Make it look brutalist, technical, and high-end.
Do not center-align the app container. Left-align text for developer readability.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use MUI Icons.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders, NOT shadows.
Always explicitly set text color on hover. Do not rely on inheritance.
